banned: 🚫 You have been banned from using this bot.
start_text:
👋 Hi, {name}!

📄 Send a PDF — I'll read it for you, no need to install any app or PDF reader, and no annoying ads to deal with!

📸 Send image(s) — I'll turn them into a clean PDF in seconds.

Just send an image or a PDF to get started! 👇
force_sub_required: 📢 To use this bot, please join the channel(s) below, then press "✅ Check":
force_sub_still_not: ❌ You haven't joined all channels yet. Join them and check again.
force_sub_passed: ✅ Confirmed! You can now use the bot.
info_text:
ℹ️ **About this bot**

📄 Send a PDF — I'll read it for you! No more installing random PDF reader apps just to deal with their annoying ads.
📸 Send an image → I'll turn it into a clean PDF, fast.

You can send several images in a row, then press "✅ Done". If you don't send a new image or press the button within 30 seconds — the PDF is created automatically.

👨‍💻 Admin: @{admin_username}
ask_filename:
✏️ Type a name for the PDF (within 30 seconds):

If you don't, a default name will be used.
pdf_processing: ⏳ PDF received, splitting into pages... Please wait.
pdf_read_error: ❌ Couldn't read this file. It might be corrupted or protected.
busy_awaiting_filename: ⚠️ Please enter a name for the PDF first (or wait 30 seconds for the default name) — you can do something else after that.
busy_building: ⚠️ The PDF is being built right now, please wait — you can start a new action once it's done.
busy_reading_pdf: ⚠️ The previous PDF is still being processed, please wait — you can send a new file once it's done.
limit_create_reached:
⚠️ You've reached your daily PDF creation limit ({used}/{limit}).

🕛 Your limit resets automatically tomorrow at 00:00 (Tashkent time).
limit_read_reached:
⚠️ You've reached your daily PDF reading limit ({used}/{limit}).

🕛 Your limit resets automatically tomorrow at 00:00 (Tashkent time).
max_images_reached: ⚠️ You've reached the max number of images for one PDF ({max}). Press "✅ Done".
premium_ad: 🌟 Don't want to wait until tomorrow? Upgrade to Premium: your daily limits get bigger and new features unlock!
ask_message_for_admin: ✉️ Write your message (text, photo, video or file) — the admin will reply soon.
message_sent_to_admin: ✅ Your message was sent to the admin.
admin_only: ⛔ This command is for admins only.
admin_search_prompt: 🔎 Type a user ID or username:
admin_ask_user_message: ✏️ Write the message to send to this user:
admin_ask_limit_value: ✏️ Enter the new daily limit as a number (0 = unlimited):
admin_ask_global_limit: ✏️ Enter the new value as a number (0 = unlimited) — applied to ALL users immediately:
admin_broadcast_prompt: 📣 Send the message you want to broadcast (text, photo or video, with a caption if you like):
admin_ask_tg_channel: ✏️ Send the required Telegram channel — its ID (e.g. -1001234567890) or @username, either works. The bot must be an ADMIN there.
admin_ask_ext_link:
✏️ Send the external link (Instagram etc.) — as "Name | https://link", or just the link itself (the name will be auto-detected).

This link is NEVER checked and its member count is NEVER tracked.
admin_channel_add_error: ❌ Couldn't add this channel. Make sure the bot is an admin there.
admin_ask_remove_channel: ✏️ Enter the number of the channel to remove:
premium_info_text:
🌟 **Premium**

With Premium your limits are extended:

📄 Daily PDF creation: {p_create} (standard: {s_create})
📖 Daily PDF reading: {p_read} (standard: {s_read})
🖼 Max images per PDF: {p_images} (standard: {s_images})

⏳ Duration: {duration}
💰 Price: {price_uzs} UZS or {price_usdt} USDT

💳 Bank card — pay in UZS
🪙 Crypto — pay in USDT

⌛ Your Premium has expired.

Tap the button below to get Premium again.

pay_no_tokens: ⚠️ Crypto payment is not available right now.

pay_choose_card: 💳 Which card will you pay to?

💳 **Pay by bank card**

🏦 Bank: {bank}
💳 Card: `{number}`
👤 Owner: **{owner}**

💰 Amount: **{amount} UZS**

📮 Address: `{address}`

⚠️ **Attention:** send only to this address on the **{token} ({network})** network. Funds sent via another token or network cannot be refunded.

pay_network_details_other:

📮 Address: `{address}`

💰 Amount: equivalent to **{amount} USDT**

ap_invalid_price: ⚠️ Please enter a number greater than 0 (e.g. 25000 or 1.5).
ap_subs_title:
👥 **Premium subscribers** — total: {total}

Tap one to open the user card.
ap_ask_grant_id:
